description: Creates and returns access and refresh tokens for authorized client applications that are authenticated using any IAM entity, such as a service role or user.

researchLinks.description: Apps can now impersonate human access to AWS via IAM Identity Center

securityImplications: Attackers might use CreateTokenWithIAM to mint IAM Identity Center access and refresh tokens from a compromised IAM entity or application, impersonating a user's single sign-on access to AWS accounts.
